Tuin Doom RPG Heavy Radio Support provenance
================================================

The first-person radio sprites and radio/teleport sounds used by the Heavy's
support-call ability were adapted from the user-supplied JohnnyDoomFINAL.pk3.
Only the radio presentation assets needed by this feature were imported.

The temporary support marines use UZDoom's native ScriptedMarine actor and the
standard Doom player sprites; no Johnny Doom marine actor definitions or marine
sprite sets were copied.
